cohort: Newborns delivered at King Abdulla University Hospital in Jordan between January 2008 and December 2020, with a focus on 13 cases diagnosed with depressed skull fractures.
finding: Ping-pong skull fractures have an incidence of 3.0 in 10,000 live births in the Jordanian population, are mostly associated with difficult deliveries, and have an excellent prognosis with conservative treatment.
mod_finding: Nine out of 13 DSF cases were associated with instrumental delivery, with seven delivered vaginally and two by C-section after unsuccessful instrumental delivery; four spontaneous cases were delivered by C-section.
